limitations: No randomized/matched-state closed-loop causal intervention; learning mechanism remains hypotheses.
RGB bright saturated connected-component assay is validated on TRAIN approach/align but is a proxy under student OOD; tiny/masked/dark bands and same-colored objects can confound it.
Robot-to-robot/body obstruction contact ledger absent. Same-end close occupation is not proof of physical collision; target-finger signed gaps are not blocker clearance.
TRAIN successful selected local rows only; failed/excluded teacher recordings are not counted as TRAIN.
C1/C2 results are not part of this analysis; local candidate definitions read only; no remote C1/C2 operations.
